reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-random message. I said I'd noted that the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats and that I hadn't done anything else with it.

I also told her I don't keep records between conversations. Her earlier post in #north-team is still where people will look, so I suggested she put the correction in that thread too. I didn't read or post in #north-team myself, since she said no action was needed.

The seat count is an account fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in #north-random, so repeating it there was fine.
